description: Select the shipping method for the current cart's checkout by an id from get_shipping_options. Only 'worldwide' exists today and it is already the default, so this call is optional — use it when the human explicitly picks a method, or once more methods appear. Needs at least one item in the cart; an unknown option_id returns an error and changes nothing. Repeating it is harmless.
name: set_shipping_method
title: Set shipping method
